items.text: Unfinished game that Is desperately trying to abandoned. Can't release a buggy game to 1.0 and not expect back lash. The way the community and mods is responding to the back lash is the reason for the negative review. A game you can still enjoy despite it's flaws but don't expect there wont be any, that's lots of flaws
items.text_zh: 一款未完成的游戏，正拼命地想要被放弃。你不能把一款满是bug的游戏发布到1.0，还指望没有反弹。社区和版主对反弹的回应方式，正是给出差评的原因。这是一款尽管有缺陷但你仍然可以享受的游戏，但别指望不会有任何缺陷，缺陷可多了。

observations.description: 社区和版主对差评的回应方式
observations.evidence: The way the community and mods is responding to the back lash is the reason for the negative review
observations.evidence_zh: 社区和版主对强烈反对的回应方式才是给出差评的原因
